newsitem.title: GREECE: CITIBANK LAUNCHES GUARANTEED SHARE INDEX FUND.
newsitem.headline: CITIBANK LAUNCHES GUARANTEED SHARE INDEX FUND.

text.p: Citibank will introduce a new stock index mutual fund aiming to capitalise on the Greek bourse's performance in 1997 with a guarantee feature on investors' capital in case stocks head south next year.
The fund, Citi-Athens 1, will fully track the bourse's benchmark share index and its one-year return will depend on how the index performs from January 20 to January 19 1998, Citibank said.

In case the index turns out negative returns next year, shareholders of Citi-Athens 1 are guaranteed a minimum net asset value per share. The minimum investment was set at one share at a price of 2.5 million drachmas.
But Citibank did not specify the minimum guaranteed share price in case of negative returns in the stock market next year.
It said shares in the new fund will not feature any front loads during the presubscription period from January 2-17.

"The investment will seek to benefit by any positive performance of the share index during the above period with a set return cap twice the prevailing one-year interbank offer rate (Athibor) on January 24," Citibank said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
